subject.title: Feature: Granular Discord action gates (split actions.messages into read/edit/delete)

question: Should Discord message permissions become independent send/read/edit/delete gates, and what canonical upgrade shape should replace the existing coarse boolean?
rationale: Granular gates improve least privilege and remove a discovery/runtime contradiction, but they change a shipped security-sensitive configuration contract and require intentional upgrade semantics.

options.title: Granular canonical gates
options.body: Adopt independent gates, migrate or normalize the shipped boolean at a bounded compatibility boundary, and make discovery and runtime consume the same effective policy.

options.title: Keep the coarse gate
options.body: Retain the grouped permission and instead correct and document the current send discovery/runtime inconsistency.

recommendation.title: Granular canonical gates
recommendation.body: Adopt independent gates, migrate or normalize the shipped boolean at a bounded compatibility boundary, and make discovery and runtime consume the same effective policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both Discord action discovery and runtime enforcement.
